shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The pop-up panel, the only lifted surface.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes and the pop-up entrance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a band: Oxide Red, press-cut corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9A3B22; color: #FFF8F0; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, #9A3B22 88%, #2A211B); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2A211B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter second action: umber outline on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #2A211B; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #2A211B; border-radius: 2px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EDE3D3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2A211B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Heading
components.description: Display heading with the olive accent words (the One Flourish Rule).
components.css: .ds-hero { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 4.5rem); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #2A211B; } .ds-hero-accent { color: #56642A; }

components.name: Pop-up Panel
components.description: The only lifted surface: paper, 2px corners, the overlay shadow.
components.css: .ds-popup { background: #F7F1E8; color: #2A211B; border-radius: 2px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(42 33 27 / 0.20); font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview: A well-made printed almanac: warm paper, dark umber ink, oxide red kept for the things a visitor can act on, and field olive for the occasional flourish. The page persuades by reading well. Type carries the voice; colour stays restrained and never decorates for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds, umber ink, one red for action.
Fraunces headings over Source Serif 4 reading text.
Press-cut 2px corners on buttons and images.
Olive appears on two things only: hero accent words and countdown numerals.

rules.name: The One Flourish Rule
rules.body: Olive appears only on the hero accent words and the countdown.

rules.name: The Red Means Act Rule
rules.body: Oxide Red marks what a visitor can press or follow: buttons, links, the banner. Never a heading colour, never a background band.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Regular for reading, semibold for headings and button labels. Nothing lighter, nothing heavier.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Bands and images sit flat on the paper. Only the pop-up panel lifts.

dos: Do keep Almanac Paper (#F7F1E8) as the ground for most of every page, with Folded Linen (#EDE3D3) for alternate bands.
Do use Oxide Red (#9A3B22) for buttons, links and the banner, and nothing else.
Do set every heading in Fraunces at weight 600 and every paragraph in Source Serif 4.
donts: Don't use Field Olive anywhere but the hero accent words and countdown numerals.
Don't round corners past 2px or add shadows to bands, images or buttons.
Don't set body text in Fraunces; it is a display face.
